response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to event-driven systems and AI-agent tooling, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing financial risk/credit systems — critical requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Experienced in event-driven architectures and real-time systems via GISCollective and DLang work
Demonstrated hands-on involvement in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Strong engineering culture advocacy through testing, CI/CD, and knowledge sharing initiatives
concerns: No visible track record leading engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or developing senior technical leadership layers
Lacks explicit experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk modeling, or regulated financial AI systems
No evidence of designing model-agnostic agentic frameworks with feedback loops, observability, or compliance infrastructure
